notes: Mt Auburn east of Reading Road: Dover, Fowler, Symmes, Marquis and Boone running north-south, Manitou, Arden and Des Moines east-west, Florence Av. diagonal. Names printed without a suffix (SYMMES, MANITOU, MARQUIS, BOONE, DOVER, FOWLER, DES MOINES, ARDEN) recorded as '... Street'. Arden is printed 'ARDEN (MARION)' (old name Marion). Manitou: Manitou crosses the C.L.& N. R.R. between Marquis and Tunnel Alley only as a 'FOOT BRIDGE'; Marquis ends at Manitou (railroad north of it). Tunnel Alley is the 20 ft way between the railroad and Boone; it is unnamed here and named from sheet 186 ('ALLEY' / 'TUNNEL'). The 20 ft alley midway between Symmes and Marquis is printed 'ALLEY' north of Arden (unnamed, listed under alleys) and 'LAWRENCE' south of Arden; the south part is recorded as 'Lawrence Alley' (only 'LAWRENCE' is printed) so it does not get tied to the downtown Lawrence Street. Arden east of the railroad: a paste shows lot 634 and two auto sheds drawn in the north half of the Arden roadway between the railroad and Boone; sheet 177 shows Arden 50 ft through to Boone, so the Arden centreline is kept on its west-of-railroad alignment (y~1308 at Boone). Arden ends at Boone where Boone runs into Florence Av.; the Boone/Florence point is where Boone's centreline meets Florence's (pipes join there). Marquis / Florence / Farrells Court / Des Moines form one wide junction: Des Moines (30 ft) ends at Marquis' centreline; Marquis meets Florence's centreline at (2895,2350) and continues across it as the court printed 'FARRELS CT' (sheet 177 prints 'FARRELLS CT.'; spelled 'Farrells Court' here so the two sheets join), which runs SE onto sheet 177; both names are recorded at that crossing. Florence Av. comes in from the bottom left as the continuation of 'DORCHESTER AV.' across Reading Road (both names recorded at that crossing), runs ENE, curves north, takes in Symmes (Symmes' east side ends at a wedge point at ~(2067,3562); the T is where Symmes' centreline meets Florence's), then runs NNE to an angle point and NE to Marquis and Boone, leaving the sheet at the right edge. 'PARK ENTRANCE' (80 ft) leaves Florence at the bottom curve heading ESE; named Eden Park Entrance as on sheet 177 ('EDEN PARK ENTRANCE'). Fowler (about 30 ft, width not printed) is only a stub from the top edge to Manitou. Width labels: Reading 70', Florence 60', Park Entrance 80', Symmes/Manitou/Marquis/Boone/Dover 50', Arden 50' (vertical label in Arden just east of Symmes), Des Moines 30', Tunnel Alley and Lawrence 20'. The ENE lines between Reading Road and Dover in the top-left (area referenced to sheet 185) are lot lines, and the dash-dot line crossing Dover is a boundary line, not a street. Deer Creek Road (unlabelled here; the gap carries the '167' sheet reference and matches 'DEER CREEK RD' on sheet 177) leaves the south side of Florence's west leg between block corners at ~(1103,4487) and ~(1323,4450); its lines are about 60 ft apart (width not printed) and it runs off the bottom edge.
